'''Nyny''' was a [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Unidentified Nyny species|three-headed sentient species]]<ref name="CE" /> located in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[17 ABY/Legends|Thirteen years]] after the [[Battle of Endor|Battle of Endor]], Nyny was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="NR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Nyny was first mentioned in the novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'',<ref name="NR" /> which was written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]] and released in [[1996]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Nyny system/Legends|Nyny star system]] and the planet itself in grid square T-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
